observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 98.» (L14) and «p. 99.» (L38) in the right margin.
body L23, L33: the letters of the references (b) and (c) are bold italic; so is the letter a of «adnotationis a» in notes 1 and 4.
body L2: a speck stands under the last e of «quantitate»; it is not a sign.
body L35: a small speck stands after «ob» before «varios»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L1: the second c of «Codicis» is printed broken, like an r.
notes_left L3: «GE′H»: the E is marked with a prime, to be told from the E of the figure.
notes_right L2, L4, L7: the 1 after T and X is a small figure set low (T₁, X₁).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
